title: Sea La Vie | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Private Pool + Gulf View + Steps From Beach- Sea La Vie By Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Sea La Vie by Royal Destinations Location: Santa Rosa Beach Address: 25 Beach Walk Lane Details: Searching for a 30A vacation rental with a large private pool, great backyard space, Gulf views, and close proximity to the beach access? Look no further than Sea La Vie! Sea La Vie is a well-appointed Blue Mountain vacation rental located south of 30A on a private, gated street in the Gulf View community. This 30A vacation rental has been completely renovated and is professionally decorated in coastal-chic decor. With a living room, game room, decks, and a large backyard, everyone has room to spread out in this fantastic home. Access to South Walton’s white sand beach is only a short walk away. Those searching for 30A vacation rentals with private pools are sure to enjoy lounging outdoors. Enjoy Gulf views from the fourth floor crow’s nest. Gulf Place’s restaurants and shops are a short walk or bike ride away! If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: 170 Yards (2 Minute Walk) -Parking Spaces: 4 Spaces in Driveway -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 10, Bar Seating for 4 -Coffee Maker Available -Gas Grill Available (Propane Provided) -Private Heated Pool: 15’ x 20’ *Pool heat is available for an additional $280 (pre-tax) *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 10 5 Bedrooms / 4.5 Bathrooms First Floor: -Bedroom 1 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 2: Queen Bed with Shared Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 3: Twin/Twin Bunk with Shared Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) Second Floor: -Kitchen / Living Area / Dining Area -Half Bath -Laundry Third Floor: -Bedroom 4 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 5: Queen Bed with Private Bath (Shower) Fourth Floor: -Crows Nest Access with Gulf Views Amenities Include: -2 Adult Bikes Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
